caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with a side writing surface attached to the left arm. The chair is shown in a three-quarter view and has a natural light brown wood color throughout. It features a curved crest rail at the top, with six vertical spindles forming the backrest. The seat is contoured and supported by four legs, each with turned details and stretchers connecting them for added stability. The right arm is rounded and leads into the backrest, while the left arm supports a broad, flat, rounded writing surface that projects outward. Below the seating area on the left side, there is a small rectangular drawer. The background is plain and off-white, and the name "Eugene Croe" is written in purple cursive near the bottom center of the image.
title: Windsor Desk Armchair
